1. stim surface LDL R ->uptake LDL    2. ↓VLDL into blood    3. Net ↓blood LDL, ↑HDL, ↓TG

▪︎goal LDL on statin: <100 (borderline/intermediate); <70 (high; ASCVD not very high risk); <55 (ASCVD very high risk); AACE (2025): <70 for ↑risk/ASCVD
Myalgias: USU ⍉ ↑ CPK, try alt statin or hold and so 2nd trial
Rhabdomyolysis: CPK> 10,000 OR CPK 10x norm + ↑ SCr OR need IVF  -Reversible on d/c
Efficacy: fasting lipid (6-8Wk post-start/titrate + periodically) -baseline & % from baseline
Asym: ⍉ monitor, Sx: stop statin -regardless of level
Bile acid-sequestesterants sig ↓ [serum] ->take 1-4 hr post bile-acid s.
